trigger: A Claude pairwise response duplicated criterion O-02 and failed deterministic criterion-set validation.
policy: Preserve the original response and status. Retry only malformed or request-failed cells in a numbered child attempt folder using the same frozen prompt, response schema, model, temperature, and seed. Use the first valid child response as the resolved cell. Never edit, deduplicate, impute, or manually adjust a score.
scope: Applies symmetrically to every judge and every absolute or pairwise campaign cell.
effect_on_planned_sample_size: None. The campaign still contains 216 absolute cells and 72 pairwise cells; attempts are transport/schema resolution records, not additional ratings.
